newsitem.title: BRAZIL: VASP eyes acquisition of Argentine carrier.
newsitem.headline: VASP eyes acquisition of Argentine carrier.

text.p: Private Brazilian airline VASP said on Wednesday that it had approached Spain's flagship carrier Iberia over the possibility of acquiring a controlling stake of its Argentine subsidiary, Aerolineas Argentinas.

A VASP spokesman said the company had sent Iberia a letter of intent with a proposal to acquire Aerolineas Argentinas, but refused to confirm newspaper reports that it had made a $300 million bid for the Argentine airline.
"VASP is interested in taking a controlling stake in Aerolineas Argentinas," said the spokesman, who asked not to be identified.
By acquiring Aerolineas Argentinas, Vasp plans to expand its flights throughout the Mercosur region, the spokesman said.
Currently VASP owns Bolivia's Lloyd Aereo Boliviano, Ecuador's Equatoriana de Aviacion and Argentine domestic carrier Transportes Aereos Neuquinos (TAN), he said.
